response.original_title: I Saw Something on the Mountain
response.overview: We may already have an idea of what is on the mountain. The project ‘I Saw Something on the Mountain’ is a reconsideration of the missing fragments of history or an exploration of gaps in the timeline of history, filling them with interpretations through various types of evidence and ways of thinking. This goes back to the last point before that gap occurred on the timeline, from calculations of solar eclipses and beliefs about solar events to the ‘God Hand’ event in the manga ‘Berserk,’ which references and interprets religious beliefs.  In the context of contemporary Thai politics, who or what are we governed by? How long has it been this way, or has it never changed at all? Just as capitalism has not differed much from the feudal system of 500 years ago, where a group of people holds resources in their hands. So, what exactly is on the mountain?
